semantics.function: q is 1 exactly when a and b are both 1
semantics.timing: Continuous combinational response; no clock cycles or specified propagation delay
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior
semantics.initialization: No stored state or initialization required

numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic, rounding, truncation, saturation, or overflow

verification.oracle: Explicit expected truth-table values derived from the original waveform
verification.coverage: Exhaust all four binary input pairs and all sixteen transitions between pairs
verification.method: Independent self-checking testbench compares q using case inequality after settling
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12, -g2012, explicit dev_tb top; finite compile and simulation timeouts

specification_ambiguities: Behavior for X/Z inputs is unspecified by the binary waveform; no additional acceptance requirements are imposed.
